newsitem.title: USA: London firm buys 10.8 pct Cubist stake.
newsitem.headline: London firm buys 10.8 pct Cubist stake.

text.p: International Biotechnology Trust PLC, a London-based investment trust, said Monday it has acquired a 10.8 percent stake in Cubist Pharmaceuticals Inc, of Cambridge Mass.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, International Biotechnology said it holds 1,116,327 comon shares of Cubist.

Of the total, it said it bought 816,327 shares from Cubist on July 18 in a private placement at $6.125 a share. It also bought 300,000 additional shares in the open market on July 24 at $6.00 a share or $1.8 million, it said.
International Biotechnology, which is an investment trust, said it holds the stake in Cubist for investment purposes.
